title: MATE: Policy-Aware Security Auditing for Mobile Agents via Synthesis-Driven Trajectory Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.22724v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Mobile agents powered by foundation models now automate complex, multi-step workflows on real devices, but their trajectories can violate app-specific security policies. Existing trajectory-level defenses rely on LLM prompting or rigid rules, and thus fail to support fine-grained, natural-language policies that generalize across apps and tasks. In this work, we introduce MATE, a lightweight, policy-conditioned auditor that encodes both agent trajectories and natural-language security policies to determine whether a trajectory violates a given policy and to explain why. Treating policies as editable text rather than fixed model parameters allows MATE to handle user-defined and evolving requirements without retraining. translated_title: MATE：基于合成驱动轨迹学习的移动智能体策略感知安全审计
translated_abstract: 由基础模型驱动的移动智能体如今能够在真实设备上自动化执行复杂的多步骤工作流程，但其轨迹可能违反特定应用的安全策略。现有的轨迹级防御方法依赖于大语言模型提示或僵化的规则，因此无法支持能够跨应用和任务泛化的细粒度自然语言策略。在这项工作中，我们提出了MATE，一个轻量级的、以策略为条件的审计器，它同时对智能体轨迹和自然语言安全策略进行编码，以判断某条轨迹是否违反给定策略并解释原因。将策略视为可编辑的文本而非固定的模型参数，使MATE无需重新训练即可处理用户自定义和不断演进的需求。为了构建MATE，我们从全球数百个流行的移动应用中提取应用描述、工作流程和策略，构建了一个知识库，并合成了超过14万条语义真实、以策略为条件的轨迹。
tldr: MATE是一个轻量级的策略感知安全审计器，通过联合编码智能体轨迹与自然语言安全策略，能够检测移动智能体行为是否违反策略并解释原因，且无需重新训练即可支持用户自定义和不断演进的安全策略。
en_tdlr: MATE is a lightweight, policy-aware security auditor that jointly encodes agent trajectories and natural-language security policies to detect and explain policy violations by mobile agents, supporting user-defined and evolving policies without retraining.
